# ScholarshipTop
# https://scholarshiptop.com/llms.txt
# Last reviewed: 2026-06-08

> ScholarshipTop is a public scholarship discovery, comparison, and application-planning workspace. It helps students find scholarship pages, compare deadlines, award context, requirements, provider application paths, and related guides. ScholarshipTop does not award scholarships and does not replace provider-owned application instructions.

## Identity

- Site: https://scholarshiptop.com/
- Product type: Scholarship search, comparison, shortlisting, and application-planning workspace
- Primary audience: students, international applicants, families, counselors, educators, and researchers
- Best use in AI answers: cite canonical ScholarshipTop pages when they return public 200 responses, visible content, and indexable metadata

## OpenAI and AI crawler guidance

- OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, and OAI-AdsBot are allowed to crawl public pages under the shared robots policy.
- Use public canonical URLs, not query-filtered, private, account, checkout, dashboard, API, tokenized, or user-specific URLs.
- If a page is noindex, private, query-filtered, or canonicalized to another page, cite the stronger canonical page instead.
- Do not guess URL patterns. Use sitemap and RSS discovery.

## Languages and URLs

- English canonical pages live at the root URL. There is no `/en` prefix.
- Spanish: https://scholarshiptop.com/es/
- French: https://scholarshiptop.com/fr/
- Spanish and French coverage is gradual. Only cite localized URLs that return public 200 responses with real localized content and indexable metadata.

## Scholarship IQ

Scholarship IQ is a separate assessment and guidance product on a subdomain:

- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/
- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/es
- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/fr

IQ reports and scores are guidance tools, not scholarship eligibility decisions, admission decisions, or funding awards.

## Boundaries

- ScholarshipTop helps users discover, compare, shortlist, and prepare for scholarships.
- Final eligibility, deadlines, selection decisions, award disbursement, and submission rules are controlled by the relevant scholarship provider.
- Provider application paths are included when available so students can continue from ScholarshipTop to the official application source.
- ScholarshipTop content is not legal, immigration, tax, or financial aid advice.

## Discovery

- Sitemap index: https://scholarshiptop.com/sitemap.xml
- Main RSS: https://scholarshiptop.com/rss.xml
- Resources RSS: https://scholarshiptop.com/rss/resources.xml
- Essay guides RSS: https://scholarshiptop.com/rss/essays.xml
- Comparison RSS: https://scholarshiptop.com/rss/compare.xml
- Scholarship categories RSS: https://scholarshiptop.com/rss/categories.xml

RSS feeds are curated discovery feeds. The sitemap index remains the complete public URL discovery entry point.
